name: Lilian Ramos
text: I recently had the pleasure of working with MF Projects (Alexandre) who conducted a comprehensive snagging inspection on our new property, and I cannot recommend their services highly enough. From the moment they arrived, it was clear I was dealing with a true professional, punctual, methodical, and deeply knowledgeable about construction standards and building regulations. Their attention to detail was outstanding. Every room, surface, fixture, and fitting was meticulously checked, and even the smallest defects that would have gone unnoticed to the untrained eye were identified. What impressed me most was not just the thoroughness, but also the clear and practical explanations provided for each issue, everything was communicated in a way that was easy to understand, with no technical jargon. The final report was delivered promptly and was incredibly well-organized. It included detailed notes, high-quality photographs, and clear recommendations. This made it straightforward for us to approach the builder with documented evidence, which added credibility to our claims and ensured that the necessary remedial work was taken seriously. It’s rare to come across someone who combines technical expertise with genuine professionalism and courtesy. Alexandre provided a service that was not only technically excellent but also reassuring and stress-free. If you’re buying a new home and want peace of mind, do yourself a favor and book a snagging inspection with this expert. You’ll be glad you did.
